# Block

> One of the cleanest org-wide rollout case studies — published an actual maturity ladder and adoption numbers.

**The headline:** **95% adoption** across engineering, **30–40% of code generated by AI** in legacy codebases. They publish a Stage-1 through Stage-6 maturity ladder.
